meta.title: Your own website for your rental - commission-free | SvojSmeštaj
meta.description: A website for your rental, ready in a week. No cut taken by Booking or Airbnb. Start €499, Business €699 with calendar sync.

heroLede: Your own website for your rental - without the cut Booking or Airbnb takes, and without anyone else's rules. Ready in a week.
heroTrust: We know what you're going through - we've been there too.
painTitle: Platforms charge more and more, and call all the shots.
pain1Text: The platform takes its cut from every booking - money that could have stayed with you.
pain2Text: Cancellations, prices, how your listing shows up - the platform dictates it all, not you.
pain3Text: The guest stays a „platform guest”, not your guest you can reach out to again.

calcTitle: How much does commission cost you per year?
calcLede: Move the sliders and see your number.
calcLostYear: That's what you give platforms each year
calcNote: The calculation uses a 15% commission. Booking.com charges hosts around 15-18% per booking, and Airbnb up to 16% when the host pays the full fee - your real loss is probably higher.
stepsTitle: From a call to a live site - three steps.
step1Title: You send us photos and info
step1Text: Photos of your place, a short description and your contact details - that's all we need to get started.
step2Text: It all happens in less than a week - you don't have to worry about a thing.
step3Text: Guests contact you directly. If you want to change something, there's a 45-minute revision session - just tell us what you'd do differently.
valueTitle: What do you actually get for €12 a month?
value1Text: The site is available to guests all over the world - it loads fast anywhere, and we aim for 99.999% uptime. Hosting and infrastructure are on us.
value2Text: We protect the site from attacks, keep an eye on everything running smoothly, and regularly back up all your data.
value3Text: Once a year you can get a refreshed look for your site - say, before the season - so you're ready for new guests.
value4Text: A price, text or photo change - just reach out and we'll sort it at no extra cost. Message us on WhatsApp, Telegram or email, and we reply personally.
valueCardText: Less than a single burger - and your site is available worldwide, protected, with a yearly design refresh and support whenever you need it.
valueCardQuip: Cancel whenever you want. The site stays yours.
b6: 1 revision - a 45-minute call where you tell us what to change
p1: Up to 5 units/rooms on the site
p3: Sync with Airbnb and Booking calendars
p5: Basic SEO and Google Business profile
p6: 2 revisions - 45-minute calls where you tell us what to change
premiumNote: The calendar works together with Airbnb and Booking - you can slowly reduce your dependence on them while keeping them as an extra channel, switching it on or off whenever you like.
enterpriseNoteEnd: - we'll work out a custom deal.
faqQ1: How quickly can I have a site?
faqA1: Usually in less than a week, as soon as you send us photos, text and contact details. We work to get everything done fast, but never in a rush that hurts quality.
faqQ3: What if at some point I stop paying for monthly maintenance?
faqA3: No worries, the site stays yours. You'll get all the files and can host it yourself, wherever suits you.
faqA4: Whatever works best for you - we're happy to buy and manage the domain for you, or you can buy and keep it in your own name.
faqQ5: What if in the end I don't like how the site looks?
faqA5: No worries, we're here to sort it out together. The Start package includes one 45-minute revision session and Business includes two - just tell us what you'd change.
faqQ6: Can I later move from Start to the Business package?
faqA6: Of course - you can upgrade at any time. Just pay the difference and we'll gladly add the advanced features.
faqQ7: Do I have to leave Booking and Airbnb completely?
faqA7: You don't, and that's perfectly fine. The Business calendar works alongside them, so you can reduce your dependence slowly, at your own pace, or simply keep them as an extra channel whenever you need it.
faqQ8: Do you also work outside Serbia?
faqA8: Absolutely - we're glad to work with accommodation owners across the region: in Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia and Albania.
trustTitle: We build sites for people we know - not for a faceless platform.
trust1Title: We know what you're going through
trust1Text: We're not a big faceless platform - we understand what it means to work hard so every guest leaves happy.
trust2Title: A human on the other end
trust2Text: You can call us or send a message. No tickets, no waiting on a bot.
trust3Text: A new photo, a new price, a new description - reach out and we'll sort it the same day.
testimonialsNote: These are reviews from our real clients.
t1Quote: Working with the SvojSmeštaj team was excellent. The website they built shows my holiday home in the best possible light and makes it very easy for guests to find me on Google. Guests now contact me by phone far more often, which suits both of us.
t2Quote: The website I have now nicely presents all the units in my apartments in one place. People often reach out through the site now, which suits me a lot. At the same time I've kept using Booking and Airbnb, so everything works just as it should.
t3Quote: The collaboration went great - I had the first version of the site within a couple of days. After a single consultation, I got exactly the website I had in mind. The integrations work perfectly, I don't get double bookings, and people now contact me directly, so I often give them better terms and earn more myself since there's no commission. Highly recommended.

finalText: No obligation. Write us a couple of sentences about your place and we'll get back to you within the day.

tplLuxuryTagline: A clean, elegant look for luxury villas.
tplLuxuryDesc: Large photos, light colors and serif type. For a place that speaks for itself.
tplBoutiqueTagline: Warm tones and a cozy, boutique feel.
tplBoutiqueDesc: For apartments and countryside stays. Rounded cards, amenity badges and a homely look.
tplUrbanTagline: A modern site with a clear price and booking path.
tplUrbanDesc: For city apartments. A booking bar, location and transparent prices - nothing hidden.
tplNatureTagline: Green, wood and a gallery for mountain houses.
tplNatureDesc: For cabins and retreats. An interactive gallery and nearby activities up front.
tplGlampingTagline: Tents, domes and stars - luxury under the open sky.
tplGlampingDesc: For eco camps and domes. Warm tones, experiences and direct booking.
tplLuxuryAbout: Villa Aurora is a quiet villa above the sea, with endless terraces, a private pool and light in every room.
tplLuxuryReview: Space, quiet and taste. It feels like a hotel, and yet like home.
tplBoutiqueAbout: Kuća Lipa is a warm apartment among the vineyards. Wood, linen and the smell of coffee in the morning - a stay you remember.
tplBoutiqueReview: Comfortable, clean and with soul. The hosts helped with everything, and the fireplace in the evening was the highlight.
tplUrbanAbout: Studio 12 is right in the center, five minutes from Kalemegdan. Contemporary, bright and ready for direct booking.
tplUrbanReview: Great location, a clear price, no surprises. We booked in two minutes.
tplNatureAbout: Mountain house Javor looks out over forest and clearings. A wooden interior, a big landscape gallery and trails right from the yard.
tplNatureReview: We woke up to birds and mist in the valley. The gallery on the site doesn't lie - it's even better in person.
tplGlampingAbout: Luna Camp is a small eco resort among the oaks: canvas domes, a private hot tub and breakfast from the farm.
tplGlampingReview: We slept under the dome, fire until midnight, breakfast in the mist. We're coming back in September.
